def_en: Awe-inspiring, majestic, noble, venerable.
Of noble birth.
To make ripe; ripen.
To bring to realization.
A kind of clown, usually serving as an anarchic foil to the whiteface.
A wealthy or privileged person.
One who has some (contextually specified) thing.
To possess, own.
To hold, as something at someone's disposal.
A fraud or deception; something misleading.
To be strong; to have power (over).
(auxiliary) To be able; can.
The hawthorn bush or its blossoms.
To gather may, or flowers in general.
To celebrate May Day.
A maiden.

(modifying a numeral, one to twelve) In conjunction with a numeral, indicates the time within a twelve-hour period (midnight to noon or noon to midnight), specifically the time when the hour hand of a clock points precisely to the symbol or marking corresponding to the designated numeral.
In conjunction with a term representing an action or event that occurs daily, indicates the time that said action or event occurs, or first occurs.
Agreement or concurrence of opinion, will, or action.
A harmony in sound, pitch and tone; concord.
To make to agree or correspond; to suit one thing to another; to adjust.
To bring (people) to an agreement; to reconcile, settle, adjust or harmonize.
In the place of something (usually mentioned earlier); as a substitute or alternative.
To utilize or employ.
To accustom; to habituate. (Now common only in participial form. Uses the same pronunciation as the noun; see usage notes.)
That is or has or have been used.
That has or have previously been owned by someone else.
Any of several standards for short-range wireless data transmission (IEEE 802.11).
Wireless networking using one of these standards.
